page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of one thread per core. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This instance type does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, offering predictable processing capabilities. However, the lack of hyperthreading and advanced vector extensions limits its suitability for highly parallelized or specialized cryptographic and matrix math workloads.

Given its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio, the ecs.m1.medium is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is qualitatively positioned as a stable, entry-to-mid-tier resource for applications requiring consistent CPU performance without the high cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. Appropriate workloads include standard web serving, application servers, microservices, and small-scale database hosting.
